title: CGT - Limbs & Cheese
description: a random bunch for the CGT-Friends group Minecraft Server.Adds random things we wanted to have like Cheese,Mushrooms and Humanoid creature limbs dropping on death.
body:
You ever wanted to eat **Villagers**,**Pillagers**,**Zombies**,**Skeltons** or other **Players** ?
Then this mod is for you!
This mod adds items representing **limbs** of different humanoid creatures~~(including players)~~,
that you can eat and use in **different cooking recipes**.
It also adds a variety of **french cheese** like
**Comte**,**Morbier** and **Chedddar**.
You also can get consumable mushrooms(called **high shrooms**) from the **Wandering Trader**!

Adds:
+ Heads on Sticks
+ Torso's
+ Legs
+ French Cheese
+ Sheep Milk
+ Milk Baskets & Bowls
+ Wedding Ring
-----------------------------------------------------------
_this mod needs Farmer's Delight and Alex's Mobs to work fully!_
